title: Supermarket Product Detection and Recognition: Utilizing Deep Learning with Rectified Imagery

limitations.summary: Although image rectification improves detection performance for angled images, its effectiveness is subject to several 8 limitations: images as left or right-aligned.
items: Although image rectification improves detection performance for angled images, its effectiveness is subject to several 8 limitations: images as left or right-aligned.
In extreme cases, the rectified image may contain only approximately 20% of the original image content.
This limitation is particularly evident in closely captured images or racks with minimal visible structural boundaries.
